classification.difficultyReason: Follow the first construction scaffold and apply the requested parallel construction to further bent and reflex configurations.

content.prompt: For these questions, you will need to construct a parallel line. Give full reasoning.

spec.description: Open zigzag AB–BC–CD–DE with horizontal parallel AB and DE; red dashed parallel CF is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Angle ABC is 25 degrees; angle CDE is 140 degrees; a labels the complete smaller angle BCD. AB, CF and DE are parallel.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens, unknown and supplied construction visible; numerical answers hidden.

answer.worked:
Construct $CF\parallel AB\parallel DE$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle BCF &= 25^\circ &&\text{(alternate angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle FCD + 140 &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle FCD &= 40^\circ\\a &= 25^\circ+40^\circ\\a &= 65^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal parallel AB and DE connected by the zigzag BCD, with C left of B and D.

answer.worked:
Construct $CF\parallel AB\parallel DE$, with $F$ to the right of $C$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle BCF &= 35^\circ &&\text{(alternate angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle FCD+120^\circ &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle FCD &= 60^\circ\\a &= 35+60\\a &= 95^\circ\end{align*}$$

Construct $CG\parallel AB\parallel DE$, with $G$ below $C$.

spec.description: Open chain ABCDE with vertical parallel AB and DE, and an unfilled right-angle marker at C.
spec.mathematics: Angle BCD is 90 degrees; angle CDE is 164 degrees; a is angle ABC.
spec.answerVisibility: No constructed CF in the question.

answer.worked:
Construct $CF\parallel AB\parallel ED$, with $F$ above $C$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle DCF+164^\circ &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle DCF &= 16^\circ\\\angle BCF+16^\circ &= 90^\circ &&\text{(angles in a right angle)}\\\angle BCF &= 74^\circ\\a+74^\circ &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\a &= 106^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.answerVisibility: The reflex 290-degree given remains visible; no auxiliary CF or calculated angles in the question.

answer.worked:
Construct $CF\parallel AB\parallel DE$, with $F$ below-right of $C$ inside the smaller angle $BCD$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle DCF+143^\circ &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\\angle DCF &= 37^\circ\\\angle BCF+37^\circ+290^\circ &= 360^\circ &&\text{(angles at a point)}\\\angle BCF &= 33^\circ\\a+33^\circ &= 180^\circ &&\text{(co-interior angles on parallel lines)}\\a &= 147^\circ\end{align*}$$
